description: This file contains unit tests for DataElement and related classes in the WPEFramework project, validating copying, size, CRC, search, bit manipulation, and linked data operations.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: Represents a data element with methods for copying, CRC calculation, size management, search, and bit operations.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: Represents a linked list of DataElement objects, supporting buffer management and linking operations.

classes.name: DataElementParser
classes.description: Parser class for iterating and interpreting DataElement objects.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data into a DataElement or LinkedDataElement.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Retrieves or sets the size of a DataElement.

methods.name: CRC32
methods.description: Computes CRC32 checksum over a data range.

methods.name: SearchNumber
methods.description: Searches for a number in the DataElement buffer with specified endianess.

methods.name: SetNumber
methods.description: Sets a number at a given position in the DataElement with specified endianess.

methods.name: GetNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a number at a given position with specified endianess.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Searches for a sequence within the DataElement.

methods.name: SetBitNumber
methods.description: Sets bit-level numbers within the DataElement.

methods.name: GetBitNumber
methods.description: Retrieves bit-level numbers within the DataElement.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets a specific value at a given offset.

methods.name: Align
methods.description: Aligns the DataElement to certain boundaries.

methods.name: Enclosed
methods.description: Checks if a LinkedDataElement is enclosed within another.

methods.name: LinkedSize
methods.description: Returns the total size of linked elements.

methods.name: LinkedElements
methods.description: Returns the count of linked elements.

methods.name: SkipBytes
methods.description: Skips a specified number of bytes in the parser.
